mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loans (user_id, book_id, status, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{status}, #{borrowedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{returnedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, book_id, status, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at FROM loans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, book_id, status, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at FROM loans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'BORROWED'
SELECT id, user_id, book_id, status, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at FROM loans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'BORROWED' ORDER BY borrowed_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, book_id, status, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at FROM loans WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'BORROWED' ORDER BY borrowed_at ASC
